title: Concept: Zipkin tracing UI in a response
description: A Zipkin tracing UI in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: Zipkin shows every trace the estate emits, including service names, endpoints and the parameters that appear in span tags, so it maps the internal topology.
applicability: Deployments that render a Zipkin tracing UI into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: Zipkin shows every trace the estate emits, including service names, endpoints and the parameters that appear in span tags, so it maps the internal topology.
